text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — I'm spinning up a dev/staging instance of model 'atlas-7b-quant' (int8) for initial bring-up. Need quick smoke checks: correctness on simple QA, math, and small code gen. Hoping to catch major regressions before the full eval suite.
Jon: :thumbsup: Which endpoint? dev-inference-3?
Maria: Yes: dev-infer.redwood.internal/atlas-7b/int8 (temporary). I'll post a curl snippet.
Maria: ```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"}' \
  https://dev-infer.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```
Lina: I'll run the basic correctness set (5 prompts) and return outputs. Threshold: >0.9 ROUGE-L on the summarization prompt, exact match on the small deterministic ones. Is that OK?
Maria: Yes. Also include these sanity prompts: "2+2=", "Reverse 'abc'", and "Create JSON with keys name,age". Expect deterministic outputs; if not, add seed param or deterministic flag.
Sam: Noted. I'll also run a tiny code test: input: "Write a Python function to check prime" and diff against the baseline. If tokenization errors show up after quantization, note them.
Jon: deploy-bot just reported a config warning in the logs about a missing KV cache optimization flag.
deploy-bot: [bot] Warning: kernel_flag KVCACHE_OPT disabled for atlas-7b-int8. Falling back to slower (non-kv-optimized) execution path.
Lina: That could bump latencies. I'll include p50/p95 in the smoke results.
Maria: Quick checklist for the smoke run: 1) Run 5 sanity prompts + expected outputs 2) Capture latency (p50/p95) under 5 concurrent RPS 3) Run small codegen diff and check for syntax regressions 4) Note any hallucinations or missing tokens 5) Upload representative examples to the onboarding doc and tag with eval ID.
Sam: I'll post outputs here by EOD with raw responses and tokenization dumps.
Jon: If we see >5% failure on the deterministic correctness tests, we won't promote to the shared staging pool.
Lina: Small note — I once saw a quantized run change tokenization around contraction punctuation (e.g., "don't"). I'll log exact tokenizer IDs for each prompt.
Maria: Good call. Also capture model config: quant backend, llm-kernel version, and compiler flags. Paste them in the eval note.
Sam: Uploading partial results: https://internal.redwood/eval/ev-2026-03-18-001 (contains JSON samples + latencies).
Maria: Quick scan — one oddity: the codegen answer used tabs instead of spaces but logic matches baseline. Not a blocker for promote, but note for style.
Jon: I'll chase the KVCACHE_OPT flag tomorrow morning. Want to pair?
Lina: I can spare 30m at 10:30 PT.
Maria: Thanks — if anyone finds a blocker, ping #product and @ops and include the eval link. I'll mark this thread with final go/no-go after the paired check.
Sam: Will do.
Maria: Thanks team — I'll update once we've validated and either promote or roll back the dev instance.
